segments.name: Wealth management
segments.description: Provides wealth management, family affairs and lifestyle management services to high-net-worth clients while earning referral fees from brokers.
segments.evidence: The Group has one operating and reportable segment with one business activity – earning referral fee from brokers.

revenueModel.text: Brokers pay the company referral fees for referring clients, part of its consolidated wealth management business.
revenueModel.evidence: The Group has one operating and reportable segment with one business activity – earning referral fee from brokers.

changes.text: In 2025 the company agreed to sell its asset management business, including Prestige Assets International Inc. and three of its subsidiaries.
changes.evidence: On June 25, 2025, the Company entered into a definitive share purchase agreement pursuant to which the Company agreed to sell all of the issued and outstanding shares of Prestige Assets International Inc.

changes.text: In 2024 the company ceased its regulated asset management business in Hong Kong.
changes.evidence: In July 2024, Prestige Asset Management Limited ("PAM"), a Hong Kong corporation previously wholly owned by us, submitted an application of cessation of business to the SFC
